cetirizine|famotidine.explanation:
Why caution
I do not know of a well-established interaction between cetirizine and famotidine. This does not mean the combination is safe. Cetirizine is an antihistamine that can cause drowsiness and affects the central nervous system. Famotidine is an H2 blocker that reduces stomach acid and may have mild central nervous system effects in some individuals.

Possible effects
- No specific effects are well established

Why this matters
While no strong interaction is documented, combining medications that may both affect the central nervous system could potentially increase sedation or drowsiness in susceptible individuals.

What to do
Do not start, stop, or change any medicine on your own. Ask a physician or pharmacist before taking these medications together, especially if you experience unusual drowsiness or other concerning symptoms.

interferon alfacon-1|tigecycline.explanation:
Why caution
I do not know of a well-established interaction between interferon alfacon-1 and tigecycline. This does not mean the combination is safe. Interferon alfacon-1 is an immune system modulator that can affect blood cell counts and cause flu-like symptoms. Tigecycline is a broad-spectrum antibiotic that can cause nausea and other gastrointestinal effects.

Possible effects
- No specific effects are well established

Why this matters
When an immune modulator and antibiotic are used together, there may be unpredictable effects on how the body responds to infection or tolerates each medication, which could be of moderate concern.

What to do
Do not start, stop, or change any medicine on your own. Ask your physician or pharmacist before taking these medications together, as they can review your complete medical situation and determine whether this combination is appropriate for you.
